mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in the last month indicates a weakening labor market, which can lead to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts over the last two months indicates a strong demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth, thus driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods with sustained increases in housing starts.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production by more than 1% over the last two months signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO declined by more than 1% in the last two months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 2% and CPI inflation is rising, the real interest rate is likely to increase, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: rising inflation with high interest rates
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls by more than 100,000 in the last month, coupled with an increase in the unemployment rate, signals a weakening labor market, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where PAYEMS decreased by more than 100,000 and UNRATE increased.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real GDP by more than 2% over the last quarter indicates strong economic growth, which is likely to drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the quarters where GDPC1 increased by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail sales by more than 1% over the last month, coupled with a decline in industrial production, signals a contraction in both demand and supply, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where RSAFS decreased by more than 1% and INDPRO declined.
